products.product_description: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, sliced, cold smoked, SMOKED NORWEGIAN SALMON in 4 oz., 8 oz., & whole sides in vacuum packages -- KEEP REFRIGERATED, STORE AT 38 DEGREES F or Below --- THE SMOKEHOUSE OF NY, MAMARONECK, NY 10543
products.code_info: Lots 82 through 96 (listed on back of packaging) and Sell By Dates of 04/5-19/17
products.reason_for_recall: The products have the potential to be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes based on FDA sampling and analysis. During an FDA inspection, an environmental sample (973983) was collected and submitted to NRL for analysis. NRL's analysis revealed 37 out of 99 subs were positive for L. monocytogenes including both Zone 1 and Zone 2 locations.
